# The AI Music Generator

> Free AI music generator and lyrics tool for creators. Turn text into royalty-free songs and instrumentals in seconds. No copyright strikes—for YouTubers, filmmakers, and musicians.

The AI Music Generator offers text-to-music generation, AI lyrics writing, and focused tools (instrumentals, loops). Output is royalty-free and suitable for videos, podcasts, and commercial use. All tools run in the browser; no install required.

## Tools

- [AI Music Generator](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/ai-music-generator): Generate full tracks from a text prompt. Describe genre, mood, and style—get royalty-free music in seconds.
- [AI Lyrics Generator](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/ai-lyrics-generator): Write song lyrics with AI, then turn them into music. For songwriters, rappers, and content creators.
- [Text to Music](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/text-to-music): Convert text descriptions into full music tracks. Describe genre, mood, instruments—get original songs; no music theory required.
- [AI Music Tools](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/ai-music-tools): Overview of tools—full tracks, lyrics, instrumentals, and loops in one platform.
- [AI Music for YouTube Creators](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/for-youtube-creators): Royalty-free AI music for YouTube videos, vlogs, and Shorts; compliant disclosure guidance.
- [Free AI Rap Lyrics & Beat Generator](https://theaimusicgenerator.com/ai-rap-lyrics-generator): Write rap and hip hop lyrics with AI, then generate a beat or full song.
